fiscalSponsors.description: Fiscal sponsors (past and present) of this changemaker. Omitted unless the caller holds `view` permission on this changemaker. Permission is evaluated per sponsor, so entries the caller cannot view carry only the public attributes while the rest carry all of them; a single array can hold both shapes. The entries never include values for `fields` nor `fiscalSponsors` to avoid infinite recursion. Use the returned `id` to call $getChangemakerById for those details.

fields.description: For each base field, the best available value related to this changemaker. Can contain ProposalFieldValue or ChangemakerFieldValue objects. Empty when unauthenticated or when recursively querying changemakers, for example, within fiscal sponsors.
